rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals notification list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and is reframed there to the category list the design sets out: a 'Dashboard' browser title and caption, the category as the heading, a primary 'Create new' button straight under the heading, the cards under 'Notifications' and each card named for assistive technology. The list shows only the signed-in trader's organisation's notifications, because the animals backend's list serves every trader's notifications to every caller today. Plants' own list takes the same frame in the same increment, keeping its own first question. Every new string gets a Welsh machine draft, and the k6 journey keeps working against the reframed list.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list at the live-animals set root sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-032, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-002, repo-frontend-p3-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086)

On the live animals list the h1 is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button, with no paragraph and no link between them. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038-m1, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-040; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-004, repo-frontend-p3-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Pressing 'Create new' on the live animals list starts a live animals notification with status Draft in the live-animals set and lands on that set's first journey page, with or without JavaScript; opening or reloading the list creates no draft. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-006, repo-frontend-p3-106; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087; conflict c-251)

On the live animals list and on plants' list the notification cards sit under the h2 'Notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-008; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Each card on the live animals list and on plants' list has the notification's reference as its h3 and is announced to a screen reader as 'Notification <reference>'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-046; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-064, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-122; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-037; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Signed in for one organisation, a trader sees only that organisation's notifications on the live animals list: a notification started under another organisation is not listed, and searching its reference lists nothing. The animals backend's list answers a request that does not say which organisation it acts for with a refusal rather than a list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-003; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-137; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-091; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-095)

Plants' notification list has the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and the caption 'Dashboard' above its h1. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-001, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-002; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)
Plants' list's h1 reads 'Plants'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-002, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-303)

Plants' list's h1 is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button, with no paragraph between them, and pressing it starts a high-risk plants notification and lands on its commodity type page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-004, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-008, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-010, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-011, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

With Welsh chosen, every new or changed string on the live animals list and on plants' list shows its Welsh version, and each new Welsh string is marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off under the Welsh Language Standards. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-068, repo-frontend-p3-069, repo-frontend-p3-070; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-006, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-007, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-050, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-063)

The k6 journey run against the stack opens the live animals list at the live-animals set root for the crumb it posts back, creates a notification, searches the list for it by reference, finds the submitted notification's reference there, and its direct read of the animals backend's notification list says which organisation it acts for; every check passes. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-005, repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-089; conflict c-225)

rows.gate: Look at the reframed frame on both lists (browser title, caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names) and the organisation-scoped list, before the card, tab, search, filter, paging and germinal list rows copy them.
openQuestions: What plants' list heading says, when the frame names the category and the design has no plants list (c-303). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Plants', with a Welsh machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off.

How 'Create new' carries the live animals category. Default: the button keeps today's form post, which creates a live animals draft in the live-animals set and lands on its first page, so the set the button belongs to carries the category; the category stored on the record comes with the category-on-create row, and the animals frontend names the address (c-251).
rows.notes: Pass 1 slices: the frame (title, caption, h1, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names), the organisation scoping, the Welsh drafts and the k6 check. Pass 2 keeps them in one row: one page, one review, and every later list row builds on this frame. Covers req-2029 (still a question, c-303) with its default, because plants' heading is built in this same frame change. 'Use template' (req-1038) stays in its own row, because it is observable only once the Manage templates page in the split-off type-question-and-templates theme exists. Already met and kept, so no criterion: the list stays at the set root (req-1032), the search keeps its text (req-1047), the card's status-driven actions (req-1084, req-2033), no serious axe violation and no sideways scroll (req-1091), deleted notifications never listed (req-1094), a new notification listed straight away (req-1095), the k6 background count (req-1853). req-1035 (a 'Back' link to the overall home) is out of scope (c-298). Welsh (req-1090) sits here because this row first changes the list copy; later list rows add Welsh drafts for their own strings under the envelope invariant. The k6 suite joins this row because it reads the crumb from the control this row renames (c-225, c-315); the search parameter's own rename is proven in the search row, which also keeps perftests in its repos. Unchanged in substance by this re-distil; two criteria reworded to state what is shown rather than what has gone (the heading and the start button).

rows.title: Notification cards show the design's facts, on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: The card leads with what is coming, when, to whom and its status. A live animals card shows its facts in two rows, with the quantity as 'Number of animals' from the animals backend's record and the commodity as the trader chose it. The arrival date is written with the full month name, a fact the record does not hold yet reads 'Not applicable', and the arrival date is the only date the card shows. Plants' card takes the same layout with plants' own facts.
acceptanceCriteria: A live animals card shows its facts in two rows: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-070; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-038; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090; conflict c-167)

A live animals card's 'Number of animals' shows the notification's own count of animals from its record. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

A live animals card's 'Commodity' is the notification's commodity name as the trader chose it: a commodity chosen as Bos taurus shows 'Bos taurus'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-039; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-024, trace-e2e-p3-094)

Plants' card shows 'Commodity', 'Arrival date' and 'Notification status' in its first row, with a 'Late' tag beside the status when the notification is late, then 'Origin' and 'Consignor'; it shows no consignee and no quantity. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-040 to repo-plantsfrontend-p3-047, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-051; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-098)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the card layout, labels, quantity, commodity name, date format, dates dropped and 'Not applicable': one card over one list item, proven with the same seeded set of notifications. Depends on the reframe row (inc-129). The animals backend is in repos for the number of animals and the commodity name on its list item; the full list item shape, germinal facts included, sits in the germinal cards row. The status styles (req-1079) are their own row, because the 'Action required' tag can be observed only once the record carries that status, and keeping them apart lets this row and the tab, search and paging rows build without waiting. The 'Inspection' fact (req-1083) waits in the blocked outcomes row. Criterion 3 and criterion 6 reworded to state the fact shown rather than the old label.

rows.title: Card status styles on both lists, with 'Action required' on the live animals list
rows.detail: A tag is used only for a status that asks something of the trader. A draft shows a 'Draft' tag and an action-required notification an 'Action required' tag, while a submitted notification's status is plain styled text. Plants' card follows the same styles for Draft and Submitted and keeps its 'Late' tag; 'Action required' is animals only, because it rests on the health certificate.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list a draft's 'Notification status' is a 'Draft' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

On the live animals list a notification the animals backend records as action required shows its 'Notification status' as an 'Action required' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-076, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091)

On the live animals list a submitted notification's status 'Submitted' is plain styled text, not a tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-029, trace-e2e-p3-030)

On plants' list a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag, a submitted notification's status 'Submitted' is plain styled text, and a late notification shows its 'Late' tag beside the status. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-049-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-076; conflict c-301)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of inc-131, which also carries the 'Action required' tag and 'ITAHC is missing' text for a submitted notification missing its health certificate (another area's requirement). The combiner keeps inc-131's id, its animals-dashboard theme, its other area's requirement and its dependency on the split-off overview-and-review theme's submit row, which records the 'Submitted action required' status this tag reads, through externalDependsOn. Depends on the reframe and card rows. An amending notification keeps today's yellow 'Amending' tag (req-1060, in the tabs row), and the 'Completed' style (req-1739) waits in the blocked outcomes row.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
rows.detail: The design separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications, and drafts keep a home on the list. The tabs are Ministry of Justice sub navigation on the animals frontend's own list, each a link that loads the page, over the animals backend's list, which gains category and tab filters and reports the count of notifications in flight. A notification being amended stays under 'In progress'.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', as Ministry of Justice sub navigation, each a link that loads the list with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-099, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100; conflict c-299)

Opening the list with no tab chosen, or with an unknown tab, shows the 'In progress' tab chosen; following a tab link lists that tab's notifications with no search text, no chosen sort and no filter set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-036; conflict c-251)

'In progress' lists submitted and action-required notifications, 'Draft' lists drafts and 'Completed' lists completed notifications, so a draft is listed only under 'Draft' and a submitted notification only under 'In progress'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-050; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-034; conflict c-165)

A notification being amended is listed under 'In progress' with a yellow 'Amending' tag and its Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete actions. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046, repo-frontend-p3-111; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-035, trace-animals-fit-p2-047; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-031; conflict c-165)

Only the 'In progress' tab shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', matching the notifications it lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show a label alone, even when chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063)

A live animals notification whose record holds no category is listed on the live animals list under its tab. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the tab links, membership, where an amendment is listed, the count, the subheading and the list API's category and tab filters with its count: one control over one query. Depends on the card row. The tab parameter's name and its values are the animals frontend's (c-251). No completed notification can exist until the authorities' outcome feed lands (req-1082, blocked row), so 'Completed' is proven to list none of the other statuses. That following a tab also drops the additional filters is proven in the additional-filters row, which adds them. req-1099's germinal half is observed in the germinal rows, once a germinal notification exists; here it is proven by a record with no category staying on the live animals list. Plants' tabs (req-2034) wait on the plants backend in the blocked plants row.

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: The design lays the list out in one column and puts search and sort in one form with one submit control. The afternoon ruling makes it one GET form whose icon-only submit button searches and sorts on the server, so the page works without JavaScript. Today's search matches only one exact, whole reference, so it becomes a real keyword search over the reference, commodity, consignee and consignor. The sort offers three orderings, is applied for real and breaks ties so paging is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list the search and sort sit in one column above the tabs inside the 'Notifications' section, with the cards in the same column below them. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-009, repo-frontend-p3-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-013; conflict c-167)

The search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-039, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-035)

The search is submitted by a real submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and whose accessible name is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; conflict c-299)

Searching lists every notification whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains the searched text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces: part of a consignee's name finds that notification, and a lower-case part of a reference finds it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-019, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-010, repo-backend-p3-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-162)

Search, sort and the additional filters are one GET form to the list's own address, submitted by the search button; it carries the current tab, unless 'In progress', and the current page when above 1, so the result stays on that tab. Changing the sort select or a filter radio submits nothing by itself, and the list's only submit control is the search button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-033 to ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-036, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-058; conflict c-299)

The sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-026, repo-frontend-p3-027; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-028, repo-tests-p4-030; conflict c-161)

'Newest first' lists the most recently created notification first, 'Oldest first' the earliest created first, and 'Arrival date' the latest arrival date first; with no sort chosen the list is in arrival date order, newest first, with 'Arrival date' chosen in the select, and the chosen option stays chosen after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-006, repo-backend-p3-007; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-161)

Paging through a sorted list in which several notifications share the sorted date, such as drafts with no arrival date, shows every notification exactly once across the pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-008, repo-backend-p3-009; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-057)

The k6 journey run against the stack searches the live animals list for its notification and finds the submitted notification's reference, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; conflict c-225)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the one-column layout, the field copy, the icon button, the real search, the one GET form, the sort label and options, the real sort and its tie-breaker, and the sort's loss of a button of its own: one form over one query. Depends on the tabs row, whose tab the form carries. The search parameter's name is the animals frontend's; perftests is in repos because the k6 journey searches this list, so where this row renames the search parameter the k6 journey changes in the same increment (req-1852 sits in the reframe row; c-225). Already met and kept: the field keeps its text and a blank search lists everything again (req-1047). The prototype's inert search and sort (c-162) and its unselected 'Select one' option (c-161) are not built. Plants' search, sort and filters (req-2036) wait on the plants backend in the blocked plants row, and plants keeps today's search and sort meanwhile (req-2037). Build the icon-only search with the animals frontend's shared submitted-search macro that design snagging added, not hand-written Ministry of Justice classes; its button submits an action value, so the plan must check that fits the one GET form. Design has not yet said whether the lists should take that search box (an open item in the workarea's deferred notes).

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: The design keeps the extra filters out of the way until the trader needs them. They sit inside the one GET form, built from the GOV.UK details component with GOV.UK radios and a select and a Ministry of Justice date picker at each end of the date range. The filters narrow the list for real, through the animals backend's list, and a date a filter cannot use is answered with an error rather than ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Inside the search form the live animals list has an 'Additional filters' disclosure, built from the GOV.UK details component, closed when the list first loads and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; conflict c-299)

The additional filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small GOV.UK radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days', with those same words as its heading and as a visually hidden legend; choosing one and searching lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-003; conflict c-162)

The additional filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two Ministry of Justice date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each a plain text field without JavaScript; searching lists only notifications arriving between the two dates, and the entered dates stay in the fields. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-051, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-056, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-037 to ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

With JavaScript, each date picker offers a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102)

Searching with a start date that cannot be read as a date shows a GOV.UK error summary and the inline error 'Enter a real start date'; an end date that cannot be read shows 'Enter a real end date'; an end date before the start date shows 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'. Each time, 'Additional filters' is open, the entered text stays in the 'Start date' and 'End date' fields, and the list is shown without the date-range filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-003, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-019; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-047; conflict c-166)

The additional filters have a 'Status' select offering exactly 'Select one', 'Action required', 'Submitted' and 'Completed'; choosing a status and searching lists only notifications in it, and the choice stays chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-035; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-058; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-024, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-026)

Following a tab link lists that tab's notifications with every additional filter cleared, as well as the search text and the chosen sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)

The animals backend's list narrows by status and by an arrival-date range whose from and to dates are each optional. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-002, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-025, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-028; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; conflict c-162)

sources.ref: additional filters (prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030, p13-031, p13-035, p13-038-m1, p13-102)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the disclosure, the three filter columns, the date validation and the list API's status and arrival-date filters: one section of one form over one query. Depends on the search-and-sort row, whose form the filters sit in. No custom JavaScript: the GOV.UK details component, radios and select, and the Ministry of Justice date picker the animals frontend already has; build each end of the range with the frontend's own date-field kit, which now always gives the house calendar. The 'Action required' option lists what the animals backend records as action required, which the split-off overview-and-review theme's submit row adds; until that lands it lists nothing, and 'Completed' lists nothing until the authorities' outcome feed exists (req-1082, blocked row). Both options render and narrow the list now. The prototype's lack of date validation is overruled (c-166), and the 26 October ruling sets the same error shape for every answer that is missing or not valid. This row also proves the half of req-1058 the tabs row cannot: following a tab clears the filters this row adds.

rows.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and show neither a results count nor an empty-state message
rows.detail: The design pages every list 8 at a time with numbered pagination, clamps the page so a stale address never shows an empty list, and shows no count of results and no message when a list holds nothing. Because the real search and filters apply, a page link carries them. Plants' list takes the numbered pagination and drops its results line and empty messages in the same increment; its page size waits on the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-005; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-036, repo-frontend-p3-115; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-021; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092)

The animals backend's list serves 8 notifications a page, numbered from 1, and reports the page, the size, the number of elements on it, the total elements and the total pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004, repo-backend-p3-005, repo-backend-p3-014, repo-backend-p3-077)

A list of more than one page shows GOV.UK pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 and a 'Next' link before the last page; a list of one page, or of no notifications, shows the cards alone with no pagination. This holds on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-033, repo-frontend-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-033, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-034; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-022, repo-tests-p4-023, repo-tests-p4-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Opening the live animals list at a page number below 1 or not a number shows page 1, and at a page past the last shows the last page; plants' list does the same. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-032-m1; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-035; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-027)

On the live animals list every page link carries the current tab unless 'In progress', the chosen sort unless the default, the search text and every additional filter, so page 2 of a filtered list lists the same filtered set. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-031, repo-frontend-p3-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-064; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-039, trace-e2e-p2-040; conflict c-163)

Neither the live animals list nor plants' list shows a count of its results, on any tab or page: the cards follow the section's heading and controls straight away. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-044; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-019, repo-frontend-p3-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-022, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-167)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a search or filter that matches nothing shows the list with no cards and no message about the result. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-021, repo-frontend-p3-113; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-079; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-054)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a tab or list holding no notifications shows the list with no cards and no message about it, in English and in Welsh. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-022, repo-frontend-p3-023, repo-frontend-p3-105; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-038, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-300)

sources.ref: pagination and empty states (prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041, p13-042, p13-044, p13-045)
list API paging (repo-backend-p3-004, p3-005, p3-014, p3-077)
dashboard pagination and results line (repo-frontend-p3-019 to p3-023, p3-031 to p3-036, p3-105, p3-113, p3-115)
plants dashboard pagination and results line (repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021 to p3-025, p3-033 to p3-035, p3-038, p3-071, p3-079)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the page size, the numbered pagination, the clamped page, the page links carrying the list's state, and the three lines that go: all sit below the cards and are proven with the same multi-page set-up. Depends on the search-and-sort and additional-filters rows, since page links carry what they add. Plants' page size of 8 (req-2035) waits on the plants backend in the blocked plants row, so plants' numbered pagination is built on whatever page size that backend serves. The prototype's page links dropping the search and filters are overruled (c-163). Three criteria reworded to state what the page shows rather than quoting the lines removed.

rows.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success'
rows.detail: One success banner, titled 'Success', is shown when an action sends the trader back to a list. The message itself is the action's own. The flag on the redirect keeps triggering it, and plants' banner takes the same title in the same increment. The new wording goes in each list feature's own copy, because the shared action wording other pages use is not reworded in place.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification, the live animals list shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's own message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-062, repo-frontend-p3-063, repo-frontend-p3-136; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093; conflict c-252)

After deleting a plants notification, plants' list shows the same success banner, titled 'Success'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-066, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071)

With Welsh chosen, the banner's title shows its Welsh version, marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-064, repo-frontend-p3-065; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
rows.notes: One slice: the banner's title and role on both lists. The banner's message is the action's own, so plants' 'Notification has been deleted' sits in the delete row. Depends on the reframe row and on the delete row. Each list feature holds the new title in its own copy; the shared action wording other pages use is left as it is, which is a placement constraint rather than an acceptance criterion. Kept as they are, already met: the banner does not dismiss itself (req-1088), and the stale-action and problem banners (req-1089). req-1087 (a message held for the trader and shown once) is out of scope (c-252): the flag on the redirect stays. Today's copy banner is never reached, so only the delete is proven.

rows.title: The deletion message on plants' list reads 'Notification has been deleted'
rows.detail: Plants' list already shows a banner when a delete sends the trader back to it. Its message is reworded to the wording for a page that does not know the deleted reference, in plants' own list copy, with a Welsh machine draft beside it.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification in the high-risk plants frontend, plants' list shows a success banner whose message reads 'Notification has been deleted'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-066, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-067; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101; conflict c-252)

With Welsh chosen, that message shows its Welsh version, marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of inc-126, which already holds req-2032 beside the manage-notifications area's delete requirements: the same delete walk proves them all, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder. The combiner keeps inc-126's id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependencies, and merges these criteria into it. The wording goes in plants' dashboard feature's own copy; the shared action wording other pages use is left as it is, a placement constraint rather than acceptance. The 'Success' title is the banner row's (req-1086).

rows.title: 'Use template' on the live animals list
rows.detail: Starting from a saved template is offered from each animals category list. The button sits beside 'Create new' and goes to the templates page with no category chosen. Plants has no templates, so plants' list has no such button.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has a secondary 'Use template' button beside 'Create new'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Following 'Use template' opens the Manage templates page, with no category chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-012, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-052)

Plants' list's heading is followed by 'Create new' alone. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-127, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-128; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-052)
openQuestions: Which page the templates page is. Default, which the builder follows and says so: the Manage templates page the split-off type-question-and-templates theme builds; the button is a link to wherever that page lives.
rows.notes: Kept as its own row because the button is observable only once the Manage templates page exists, and that page belongs to the split-off type-question-and-templates theme, so this row waits on it through externalDependsOn rather than holding up the rest of the list. The button itself sits in the live animals list's own feature folder, which no split-off theme touches, so the row stays here. Depends on the reframe row. The germinal list's half of req-1038 is proven by the germinal list row, which copies this list once this row has landed.

rows.title: The germinal products set's root renders its own copy of the reframed list
rows.detail: Each category of animal notification has its own list. The germinal list is the germinal set's own copy of the reframed live animals list, at the germinal set's root in the animals frontend, rather than a hand-off to another service. It shows only germinal products notifications, and its 'Create new' starts a germinal notification in the germinal set.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the germinal products set's root shows its own notification list, with the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Germinal products'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-314)

The germinal list has the same 'Use template', search, sort, additional filters, tabs, numbered paging and success banner as the live animals list, each submitting to and linking within the germinal list's own address. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-061, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-064-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)

Pressing 'Create new' on the germinal list starts a germinal products notification with status Draft in the germinal products set and lands on that set's first journey page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-251)

The germinal list lists only germinal products notifications: a germinal notification just started is listed on it, and a live animals notification or one whose record holds no category is not. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

The germinal products set's root serves the list itself, with no onward hand-off to another service. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-159, c-314)

sources.ref: germinal products dashboard (trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078, p1-079, p1-081, p1-087)

rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the germinal list's frame, its controls, its 'Create new' and its category scoping with the set root serving the list itself (req-1851): one page copied once. Copies the live animals list's feature folder into the germinal set, as the set's other pages are copied. Depends on the germinal set's first row, which stores the category on create, and on every live animals list row it copies, the 'Use template' and banner rows included. The animals backend's category filter is built in the tabs row. No Summary section: it is blocked with the glance-cards row. A germinal list in the front-door service and its own 'Create new' are not built in this programme, and the earlier ruling's hand-off from the set root is overruled (c-159, c-297, c-314).

rows.title: Germinal products notifications on their own list, with their own card facts
rows.detail: A trader looking at one category must not see another's notifications. The animals backend's list returns every fact a card shows, including each notification's category and its quantity, and for germinal products its packages with each line's species and product type, so the germinal cards say what is coming in the germinal way and the live animals list leaves germinal notifications out.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification is not listed on the live animals list, and searching its reference there lists nothing. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112; conflict c-159)

A notification whose record holds no category is listed on the live animals list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112)

The animals backend's list returns, for each notification, its reference number, status, commodity name, arrival date, origin, consignee name, consignor name and category, and its number of animals or, for germinal products, its number of packages with each line's species and product type; a fact the notification does not hold comes back empty. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015, repo-backend-p3-016, repo-backend-p3-017, repo-backend-p3-078; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-040, repo-frontend-p3-045; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105; conflict c-159)

A germinal products notification's card shows its quantity as 'Number of packages', from the notification's package count. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-064; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

A germinal products notification's card shows the commodity as the species, then a comma, then the product type, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

A germinal card whose notification has no package count, species or product type yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015 to repo-backend-p3-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

sources.ref: list item (repo-backend-p3-013, p3-015 to p3-017, p3-078)

rows.notes: Pass 2 keeps the list item's full shape with the germinal cards that show it: its germinal facts can be observed only once a germinal notification with species, product type and packages exists. The live half of the item, the number of animals and the commodity name, is what the card row shows. Depends on the card row, the germinal list row and the germinal Commodity details row, which first stores the package count the card shows. The list item shape is carried by the animals backend's list view, which the split-off overview-and-review theme also touches: listed under shared for the combiner.

rows.title: Each set stores its category on the draft it creates
rows.detail: Live animals and germinal products are sibling sets keeping their notifications in one backend, so the stored record must say which set a notification belongs to. Each set passes its category when it creates a draft, so a germinal notification reaches the germinal products list and a live animals one the live animals list. A record with no category counts as live animals, so notifications stored before the germinal set existed stay on the live animals list without a data migration.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft the germinal products set creates is stored with the category germinal products, and is then listed on the germinal products list and not on the live animals list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)

A draft the live-animals set creates is stored with the category live animals, and is listed on the live animals list. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of inc-176, the germinal set's first row, which already holds req-1856 and req-1857 beside the backend category field, the cross-set guard and the set's chrome: one backend field and one create path, observable only through the germinal set's create. The combiner keeps inc-176's id, its germinal-products theme, its gate, its repos, its dependencies and its external dependencies, and merges these criteria into it. That the germinal draft then appears on the germinal list is proven by the germinal list row, which depends on inc-176; here it is observed as absent from the live animals list, whose category filter the tabs row builds.

rows.title: The live animals list says what is outstanding on a submitted notification's card
rows.detail: A trader is told on the list what still needs doing on a submitted notification that has items outstanding. The card carries the outstanding item as plain text under the reference, taken from what the record stored when the notification was submitted, with the missing certificate named first and incomplete identifiers next.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list, a submitted notification with items still outstanding shows them as plain text on its card under the reference: 'ITAHC is missing' when no uploaded document is an ITAHC or health certificate, and otherwise 'Information is missing' when its animal identifiers are incomplete, from what the record stored at submit. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-064-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-071; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-046; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-094)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of inc-147, the identifier-driven outstanding items row, which also carries the review-header warnings, the inline identifier error and the confirmation bullet from the animal-identification area: one rule, worked out once at submission and read back on four surfaces. The combiner keeps inc-147's id, its animals-dashboard theme, its other requirements and its dependencies, and merges this criterion into it. It states the card's outstanding-items text in one place, the certificate first and identifiers next, and follows the status-styles row, which builds the certificate half of the message. The record of outstanding items it reads is the split-off overview-and-review theme's, reached through externalDependsOn.

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: What needs the trader's attention sits at the top of each category list, in two glance cards whose counts agree with the pages they link to. The afternoon ruling counts these Summary cards as the front door's summary information, so they wait until its requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed page for the category, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes page for the category. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-036 to prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-042 to trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-044)

The 'Action needed' card's count is the number of the category's notifications showing an 'Action required' tag, and matches the list its link opens; a notification showing a 'Delayed' tag is not counted. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; conflict c-148, c-149)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with. Once they exist this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which pages its links open are decided then.
rows.notes: Nothing in the reframed list depends on this row. The counts are computed from the same set the page each link opens lists, for the signed-in organisation; the design's fixed glance numbers are overruled (c-148). Repos are the animals backend, the animals frontend and the tests suite, because the list it sits on stays in the animals frontend; re-check when it is re-distilled. The 'Status updated' count (req-1735) waits as well, in the outcomes row, because it also needs the authorities' outcomes.

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed, completed, inspection, their actions and the status-updated count
rows.detail: What the authorities decide after submission is shown on the list: a delayed notification with its reason, a completed notification in its own tab, an inspection warning, and the actions a card in those statuses offers. None of these outcomes reaches the service today, so the row waits on the authorities' case system; the status-updated count also waits on the front door's dashboard requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification shows a 'Delayed' tag on an error card whose message is the reason for the delay recorded on the notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows the status 'Completed' as plain styled text rather than a tag, and is listed in the 'Completed' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-065, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-066)

A notification chosen for inspection shows an extra 'Inspection' fact with a 'Required' tag at the end of its card's second row. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-069)

A card whose notification is delayed, completed, or action required with no status-driven action set of its own offers 'Copy as new' then 'View', and 'View' opens the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-047 to prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-049; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-054; conflict c-149, c-160)

The 'Status updated' glance card's count is the number of the category's notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, and matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; conflict c-148)
openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system must send post-submission outcomes (action required with its reason, inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the owners of that integration must provide the outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed.

Blocked as well, for the status-updated count (req-1735): the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Completed' status is decided when this unblocks.
rows.notes: Keeps every requirement the authorities' outcome feed blocks apart, so the list rows build now. Once unblocked, the animals backend's record takes the outcomes, statuses only ever being added, and the animals frontend's card, tabs and status filter pick them up. The 'Delayed' card's message is the recorded reason, because the design's own message there is placeholder copy. Depends on the card row, the tabs row and the glance-cards row.

rows.title: Plants' list tabs, eight a page, search, sort and filters, once the plants backend can query them
rows.detail: Plants' list takes the same tabs, paging, search, sort and additional filters as the live animals list, but each needs the plants backend, outside this programme, to query plants notifications by status, page size, keyword and arrival date. They wait together, and plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging meanwhile.
acceptanceCriteria: Plants' list shows 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs with the same count, subheadings and status grouping as the live animals list. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-032, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-072, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-302)

Plants' list shows 8 notifications a page. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-024, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-302)

Plants' list has the live animals list's one 'Search by' GET form with its hint and icon-only search button, a keyword search over the reference, commodity and consignor, the three sorts with the search button applying them, the 'Additional filters' disclosure, and page links that carry them all. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-074, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-097)

sources.ref: plants dashboard list query (repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019, p3-024, p3-025, p3-032, p3-036)

openQuestions: Blocked: the plants backend, outside this programme, must let plants' list query plants notifications by status for the tabs and their counts, ask for a page size of 8, and search by keyword, status and arrival date with the new sorts. Who: that backend's owners. Until then plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging (req-2037).
rows.notes: One row for the three plants list behaviours that wait on the same plants backend change, kept apart from the rows that build now, and recorded in the workarea's deferred notes. Build the icon-only search with the plants frontend's shared submitted-search macro that design snagging added, and the date-range fields with plants' own date-field kit, which now always gives the house calendar. Design has not yet said whether the lists should take that search box. Nothing is overruled here: today's plants list is what stays until the backend is ready (c-302).
